out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED A FOOD EMPLOYEE WITHOUT A SIGNED POLICY.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHP PROVIDED OVER EMAIL. PLEASE HAVE ALL EMPLOYEES SIGN AND UNDERSTAND A POLICY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN WITH A LADEL IN IT.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: LADEL REMOVED. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED IN (1): RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED OVER COOKED BROTH AND RAW PORK OVER COOKED BROTH OBSERVED IN (4): OBSERVED RAW PORK STORED OVER RTE SAUCE
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: COOLERS REARRANGED BY COOKING TEMPERATURE DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: OBSERVED DISHES RUN THROUGH DISHWASHER WHILE IT WAS AT ~10PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: DISHES TAKEN TO THE THREE-VAT SINK TO BE SANITIZED WITH 50-200PPM CHLORINE. GREEN BASIL DIM SUM & PHO (Inspection Date: 09/28/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. OBSERVED IN (1): TWO CONTAINERS OF PHO BROTH, COOKED THE NIGHT PRIOR, AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI: BROTH DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ON THE COUNTER: OIL & GARLIC MIXTURE AT 70F OBSERVED ON THE COUNTER: CUT CABBAGE AT 53F (1HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: GARIC AND OIL DISPOSED OF. CUT CABBAGE PUT IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED COOKED STICKY RICE AND HOMEMADE PICKLED RADISH KEPT ONSITE FOR 7 DAYS WITHOUT DATES ON THEM.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: FOODS DATED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED RAW SPROUTS ON TIME WITHOUT BEING MARKED WITH END POINT.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: RAW SPROUTS MARKED WITH TIME.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED NO CONSUMER ADVISORY STATEMENT ON THE TO GO MENU.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. CDI: PIC THREW MENUS AWAY.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed droppings and track marks from rodents under the dry storage shelving in area next to the 3 vat sink
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC agreed to clean dry storage area and call pest control to come in for servicing. Will follow up to verify compliance

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor in the dry storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC agreed to have the food moved six inches off the floor in the dry storage

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: observed salt sugar and msg being kept in the dry storage area without lids
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC agreed to acquire lids for dry storage foods

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Observed temperature at 96F
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC agreed to repair the three vat sink, will follow up with EHS when repairs are made to 3 vat sink GREEN BASIL DIM SUM & PHO (Inspection Date: 03/09/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC agreed to clean dry storage

violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Person charge agree to acquire handwashing sink cleanser will follow up in 10 days to verify COMPLIANCE

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point

violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: observed on the to go menus, no reminder statement, stating that this food may increase her chance of foodborne illness
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. Person agreed to adjust menus will fall in 10 days to verify compliance. GREEN BASIL DIM SUM & PHO (Inspection Date: 09/12/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: observed on the in restaurant, no disclosure statement for the raw or undercooked filet mignon steaks and beef
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Person in charge agreed to rewrite the menu. EHS will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. observed raw, frozen shrimp and raw pork be stored on the floor of the kitchen area next to the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Personal in charge of the raw shrimp and raw pork to being sorted inside the walk-in cooler walk in freezer on shelving unit.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed in use spiders and baskets used to cook, rice noodles being stored from wires that wear attached to the fire suppression nozzles
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Personal in charge took down wire that was attached to the fire suppression as agreed to find different solution to store and use utensils

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: Observed grease buildup on the rear part of deep fat fryers on the underside of wok grills on the wall behind the fry line and on various contact surfaces
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Person in charge agreed to have the no contact services cleaned and agreed to set up schedule for cleaning for no contact services.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: observe the outsides of rice cookers are not clean to site and punch
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Personal in charge agreed to clean the outside of rice cookers and to set up a cleaning schedule for equipment and non-food contact surfaces.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises. Observe storage of unnecessary equipment in a rear closet next to the deep fat fryer and cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. Person in charge agreed to get rid of unnecessary equipment.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the floors, wall ceilings of the kitchen in need of cleaning, especially observe the floor of the dry storage walk area in need of cleaning and the wall behind the fry and cook line was in need of cleaning
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Person in charge agreed to clean all the areas mentioned and to set up a cleaning schedule with staff.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Designed to Prevent Condensate Drip
violations.observation: Grease from the exhaust hood system at the cook line was observed dripping onto food-contact surfaces below. Observed dripping from the grease hood increase it has not been cleaned and it’s overdue for service.
violations.corrective_action: Exhaust ventilation hood systems in food preparation and warewashing areas including components such as hoods, fans, guards, and ducting shall be designed to prevent grease or condensation from draining or dripping onto food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. Person in charge schedule recent cleaning during time of inspection. Will verify compliance during follow up.
